title: Annotatio VI §.I close: No fundamental error either side — stop before §.II (Posterior Class / Formula of Concord)
pass_a_gloss: For that the Reformed differ from them by no fundamental error at all, they have long held — no less than the Reformed have long acknowledged and celebrated these Lutherans as altogether immune from every fundamental error.
pass_b_english: They have long held that the Reformed differ from them by no fundamental error at all.
The Reformed, for their part, have long acknowledged and celebrated these Lutherans as free of every fundamental error.
Stop before §. II (Posterior Class — Brenz, Andreae, Hunnius, Flacius / Formula of Concord).
source_text: Quod enim nullo omnino fundamentali errore Reformati à se diffideant, pridem tenent, non minus, ac Reformati Lutheranos hosce ab omni prorsus errore fundamentali immunes dudum agnoverunt & celebrarunt.
notes: No fundamental error either way; stop before §.II.
